title: Hatsune Miku — An Imminent Threat〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm back, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, welcome back!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
How was the flea market?
Were they selling a lot of stuff?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, lots of rare and interesting things.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I could hardly believe how big the place was, either. It really drove home that they're in a whole different country.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really...?!
I can't wait to hear what the others have to say.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It sounds like a fun time. Maybe I'll go take a peek later...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, it's nice to hear that everyone's been able to enjoy themselves before the big event.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too.
They did run into a bit of trouble earlier...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But everything ended up working out, so I'm sure they're back to enjoying themselves now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the way, MEIKO, what were you and the others doing just now? Looks like you're in the middle of cooking?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We thought that we should prepare a few light dishes before the event got underway.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If they happen to stop by after the event, I'm sure they're going to be very hungry.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We also whipped up some drinks for them, so they can feel free to shout all they like at the show!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And we made them using lots of honey! That should help their throats quite a lot♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's nice of you all to prepare these, but are they really for Akito and them? Don't tell me you're planning to sneak over and cheer your hearts out over there. If you were to get seen...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We know!
But it's a huge venue that fits a ton of people, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We figure that we can poke our heads out and cheer a little bit without being seen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, but please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: We will!
A few hours later
SONIC NOTES

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Th-That was amazing!!!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Did you hear the way they sang just now?!
Cool doesn't even begin to describe it!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <They had the audience hooked right from the beginning!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <They sang and expressed themselves in such a powerful way... Everything was flawless!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I suppose that's what it means to be world-class artists. They're on a completely different level.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<The crowd was also super loud!
You could feel the electricity in the air!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I can't imagine anyone not getting hyped up, seeing that.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I sure got hyped up myself.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
I can't help but envy them.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Envy?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I mean, they get to perform at such a huge venue! Not only that, they were able to get everybody all the way in the back going!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I know what you mean!
It has to feel amazing to sing at such a huge place!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But SEKAI doesn't have anything like that...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Well, we can't say that for sure yet.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <SEKAI is affected by Kohane and the others' feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's not impossible for a huge venue like this to appear here in the future.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Right. There's a possibility for sure.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. Then, we'll need to have songs picked out for when we do get to sing there!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We also need to have a competition to see who gets the crowd going the most!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's gonna be us! Right, Rin?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'm very much looking forward to seeing how things unfold moving forward.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <And what's going to happen to SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah, me too.>
